script: Craziest predictions in football history. So a carpenter named Leigh Herbert was on a camping holiday one summer, and after a few drinks, he put 5 pounds on his boyhood club Leicester City to win the Premier League at odds of 5000 to one. To show you how insane that is, bookies were offering those exact same odds on Elvis being found alive. But there's a reason a bet that stupid was actually the safest read on this team. The season before, they finished fourteenth and sat in the bottom three for most of that year, fully expected to get relegated. And this is a club that in 132 years had never once won the top flight. Meanwhile the title only ever went to the rich giants, because since the year 2000 just four wealthy clubs had ever lifted it. But the moment the season kicked off, Leicester started making those bookmakers sweat. And if you're enjoying the video, please hit the follow button. A group of rejects led by Claudio Ranieri won 23 games and lost only three, while Jamie Vardy and Riyad Mahrez tore defenses apart. And on May 2nd of 2016, the title was mathematically theirs. Bookmakers called it the biggest upset in betting history and lost around 11 million dollars between them. And Leigh? That nervous 5-pound bet, part of which he cashed out early because the pressure got to him, turned into over 20,000 pounds.
